report.overview: Prettier 3.10.0-dev is an opinionated, plugin-based code formatter: it parses source into an AST, attaches comments, converts that AST to a Wadler-style Doc IR, then pretty-prints to a string. The public Node API in src/index.js is fully async (format, check, formatWithCursor, resolveConfig, getFileInfo, getSupportInfo); the CLI enters through bin/prettier.cjs into src/cli/index.js, with an opt-in rewrite re-exported from @prettier/cli. Built-in languages (JS/TS/Flow, JSON, CSS/Less/SCSS, HTML/Vue/Angular/LWC/MJML, GraphQL, Markdown/MDX, YAML, Handlebars) are themselves plugins, lazily loaded, and last-registered plugins win when resolving parsers and printers.

system_map.summary: The runtime has three public surfaces: the Node ESM/CJS API (src/index.js / src/index.cjs), the CLI (bin/prettier.cjs → src/cli), and a browser standalone bundle (src/standalone.js, no config/plugin autoload). Formatting is owned by src/main/core.js; languages live under src/language-*; plugins are assembled by src/main/plugins and the generated builtin registries. Config search/load lives in src/config; the Doc printer in src/document. Development requires Node >=22 and Yarn 4; production tests still exercise dist/ down to Node 14. The website is a Docusaurus + Vite playground published via Netlify; npm packages are built by scripts/build/build.js into dist/.

claims.claim: package.json names the project prettier 3.10.0-dev, sets type module, engines.node >=22, bin to ./bin/prettier.cjs, main to ./src/index.cjs, and exports '.' (types src/index.d.ts, require src/index.cjs, default src/index.js), './standalone' to src/standalone.js, and './plugins/*' to src/plugins/*.js.
The published browser/unpkg entry is standalone.js; package.json also defines #universal import maps that swap src/universal/*.browser.js in browsers versus src/universal/*.js on Node.

bin/prettier.cjs is the real CLI bootstrap: it optionally enables Node compile cache, rejects Node versions below package.json engines.node, strips --experimental-cli / PRETTIER_EXPERIMENTAL_CLI, then dynamically imports either src/experimental-cli/index.js or src/cli/index.js and calls cli.run().

src/index.js is the Node API: withPlugins loads builtin plus user plugins, then format/check/formatWithCursor/getSupportInfo/inferParser wrap src/main/core.js; it also exports resolveConfig, getFileInfo, doc, util, version, __debug, and __internal (shared with the CLI).
src/standalone.js reimplements withPlugins without filesystem plugin loading: plugins may be an array or an object (prettierPlugins); there is no resolveConfig/getFileInfo.

Builtin plugins are generated (do NOT edit) by scripts/generate-builtin-plugins.js into development-plugins.js (language-* modules) and production-plugins.js (src/plugins/*.js bundles), then lazy-loaded via toLazyLoadPlugins. loadBuiltinPlugins() picks production vs development based on NODE_ENV.

Language implementations live in src/language-{js,json,css,html,graphql,handlebars,markdown,yaml}; each exports languages, parsers, printers, and options. JS printers are a single estree printer; HTML covers angular/html/lwc/mjml/vue parsers with one html printer.

The build is node ./scripts/build/build.js; scripts/build/packages/index.js emits four packages (prettier, plugin-hermes, plugin-oxc, plugin-yuku) into dist/. prepublishOnly exits 1 so the source tree cannot be published.

The website is Docusaurus 3 plus a separate Vite/Vue playground (website/vite.config.mjs, website/playground/). Netlify builds with yarn build:website and publishes website/build/. Playground formatting runs in a Worker at /worker.mjs.

CI is GitHub Actions: Dev runs yarn test (and c8 coverage) on Node 22/26; Prod first yarn build --clean then tests dist/ across Node 14–26, OS matrix, standalone, and Chrome/Firefox ESM+UMD via Puppeteer; Lint runs deps/tsc/eslint/prettier/cspell/changelog/format-test plus actionlint.

Config resolution is src/config/resolve-config.js: searchPrettierConfig + optional EditorConfig (editorconfig-without-wasm), mergeOverrides via micromatch, and relative plugin paths resolved against the config file directory.

The experimental CLI is a thin re-export of @prettier/cli/bin (and worker from @prettier/cli/dist/prettier_serial.js), selected by --experimental-cli or PRETTIER_EXPERIMENTAL_CLI rather than a first-party implementation in src/cli.

feature_catalog.summary: Users format via CLI, Node API, or browser standalone. The CLI writes, checks, lists, caches, and inspects files; the API formats text, maps cursor offsets, resolves config, and infers parsers. Built-in languages cover the web stack with multiple JS parsers (babel/acorn/espree/meriyah/oxc/yuku/typescript/flow/hermes). Plugins, EditorConfig, ignore files, pragmas, range format, and a playground are first-class. Prettier refuses new formatting options by policy.

claims.claim: prettier.format(text, options) is withPlugins(core.formatWithCursor) with cursorOffset -1; prettier.check is format === text; prettier.formatWithCursor returns {formatted, cursorOffset, comments}.

Public Node APIs also include resolveConfig, resolveConfigFile, clearConfigCache, getFileInfo, getSupportInfo, plus prettier.doc and prettier.util. All public APIs are async; src/index.d.ts is the shipped types.

CLI surface from src/cli/cli-options.evaluate.js includes --write/-w, --check/-c, --list-different/-l, --cache, --cache-location, --cache-strategy content|metadata, --config/--no-config, --config-precedence cli-override|file-override|prefer-file, --editorconfig, --ignore-path (default .gitignore and .prettierignore), --ignore-unknown/-u, --with-node-modules, --file-info, --find-config-path, --support-info, --help, --version.

Debug CLI flags --debug-print-doc, --debug-print-ast, --debug-print-comments, --debug-check, --debug-benchmark, --debug-repeat (and PRETTIER_PERF_REPEAT) short-circuit the format path in src/cli/format.js.

Core format options in src/main/core-options.evaluate.js include parser, plugins (--plugin, array), printWidth (80), tabWidth (2), useTabs, endOfLine (lf|crlf|cr|auto), filepath/--stdin-filepath, rangeStart/rangeEnd, cursorOffset, insertPragma, requirePragma, checkIgnorePragma.

JS builtin parsers registered in development-plugins.js include babel, babel-flow, babel-ts, acorn, espree, meriyah, oxc, oxc-ts, typescript, flow, hermes, yuku, yuku-ts plus internal __js_expression / __vue_* / __ng_* parsers.

Non-JS builtins: css/less/scss (postcss), graphql, glimmer/handlebars, html/angular/lwc/mjml/vue, json/json-stringify/json5/jsonc, markdown/mdx/remark, yaml. Parser names are also listed as core option choices.

Official in-repo extra packages @prettier/plugin-oxc, @prettier/plugin-hermes, and @prettier/plugin-yuku wrap the corresponding JS parsers, set a distinct astFormat (estree-oxc/estree-hermes/estree-yuku), and reuse the estree printer.

Plugin loading is documented for CLI --plugin, API options.plugins, and config plugins; plugin modules export languages, parsers, printers, options, defaultOptions. Strings go through import() / importFromDirectory.

Config files searched in order: package.json prettier key, package.yaml, .prettierrc, .prettierrc.json/yml/yaml/json5, .prettierrc.js/ts and prettier.config.js/ts, mjs/mts, cjs/cts, .prettierrc.toml. JS/TS configs are executed via import(pathToFileURL).

CLI --cache uses FormatResultsCache (file-entry-cache) at node_modules/.cache/prettier/.prettier-cache by default, keyed by prettier version + Node version + stable-stringified options, strategy content (checksum) or metadata (mtime). Cache is forbidden with stdin.

The playground (website/playground/PrettierFormat.js) posts {type:'format', version, code, options, settings} to a versioned Worker; docs/technical-details.md notes a special parser value doc-explorer for inspecting the Doc IR. Prettier will not accept PRs that add formatting options.

data_flow.summary: Text enters via CLI files/stdin or the format() API. Options are normalized, a parser is inferred or selected, plugins are loaded, and the parser produces an AST. Comments are attached, embedded languages may be re-parsed, printers emit a Doc, and printDocToString measures/breaks groups to a string. CLI then writes, diffs, or caches that string. Config, ignore, and EditorConfig are filesystem side channels that never run in standalone.

claims.claim: formatWithCursor in src/main/core.js: normalizeFormatOptions → normalizeInputAndOptions (BOM strip, EOL guess/normalize, index clamp) → optional pragma skip → formatRange or coreFormat → re-add BOM. Empty/whitespace-only input short-circuits to formatted: ''.

normalizeFormatOptions infers parser from filepath via inferParser if options.parser is missing, then initParser/initPrinter, copies locStart/locEnd/getVisitorKeys/astFormat onto options, and fills defaults from getSupportInfo. Throws UndefinedParserError if neither parser nor filepath is usable.

parse() in src/main/parse.js resolves the parser, optional parser.preprocess, then parser.parse(text, options, options) (third arg kept for v3 compat, slated for removal in v4). Parse errors with loc get a @babel/code-frame attached.

printAstToDoc: prepareToPrint attaches comments (attachComments) and optional printer.preprocess; printEmbeddedLanguages walks the tree; callPluginPrintFunction dispatches printer.print, prettier-ignore via printIgnored, and comment printing.

The Doc IR (string | Doc[] | commands such as group/fill/ifBreak/indent/line/cursor) is printed by src/document/printer/printer.js using MODE_FLAT vs MODE_BREAK and a fits() probe against remainingWidth. Public builders are re-exported as prettier.doc.

Cursor preservation: getCursorLocation finds cursorNode/nodeBeforeCursor/nodeAfterCursor; print wraps those nodes with the cursor symbol; coreFormat diffs old vs new region with diffArrays to compute the new cursorOffset.
Range format (formatRange) slices AST-calculated rangeStart/rangeEnd, formats with extra alignment, then splices the trimmed result back, converting EOL if needed.

CLI file input: expandPatterns (literal file, recursive dir **/*, or fast-glob; followSymbolicLinks:false; skip .git/.svn/.hg/.jj/.sl and node_modules unless --with-node-modules) → ignore() from .gitignore/.prettierignore → getOptionsForFile → formatWithCursor → optional fs.writeFile.

getOptionsForFile: resolveConfig (unless --no-config) with editorconfig flag, then applyConfigPrecedence (cli-override default), temporarily pushContextPlugins if the config lists plugins. Invalid config process.exit(2).

Config loaders execute user JS/TS/MJS/CJS via import(pathToFileURL); JSON via parse-json; JSON5 via @bybrave/json5; TOML via smol-toml; YAML via the yaml plugin's __parsePrettierYamlConfig. A string prettier field is treated as an external package and loaded with requireFromFile then importFromFile.

Standalone/browser path never searches the filesystem: plugins must be passed in; docs/browser.md states no config, ignore, CLI, or automatic plugin loading. withPlugins only Object.values(plugins) if not an array.

Embedded-language formatting (printer.embed) is skipped unless embeddedLanguageFormatting === 'auto' (default). Embed errors are swallowed unless PRETTIER_DEBUG is set. Plugins using the old embed arity throw with a v3 migration URL.

behavior_traces.summary: Three user-visible flows were walked in source. CLI startup validates Node, builds a Context from argv/plugins, then dispatches to version/help/support/config-path/file-info, stdin, or formatFiles. Formatting a file expands globs, resolves per-file options, optionally hits cache, then runs the parse→doc→string pipeline. Persistence is either in-place write via mockable.writeFormattedFile, stdout, or a check/list-different exit code.

claims.claim: CLI startup order: bin/prettier.cjs run() → version check against engines.node → shouldEnableExperimentalCli → import src/cli/index.js → cli.run(process.argv.slice(2)).

src/cli/index.js run(): parseArgvWithoutPlugins for log-level → new Context → context.init() (parse --plugin, getContextOptions, parseArgv, filePatterns=argv._) → main(context) with mutually exclusive flag checks.

main() dispatch: --version prints prettier.version; --help uses createUsage/createDetailedUsage; --support-info → printSupportInfo; --find-config-path → logResolvedConfigPathOrDie; --file-info → logFileInfoOrDie; else stdin if no patterns and (stdin not TTY or --stdin-filepath); else formatFiles; else usage + exitCode 1.

formatFiles: createIsIgnoredFromContextOrDie → optional FormatResultsCache → for await expandPatterns → skip ignored in write/check/list-different/debug-check → getOptionsForFile → fs.readFile utf8 → cache hit returns input unchanged else format() → maybe mockable.writeFormattedFile → set/remove cache → check summary + exitCode 1 if unformatted and not --write.

format() inner function: debugPrintDoc → __debug.printToDoc then formatDoc; debugPrintComments → formatWithCursor.comments JSON; debugPrintAst → JSON.stringify(ast); debugCheck double-formats and compares massaged ASTs; else performance loop or prettier.formatWithCursor.

API format path: prettier.format → formatWithCursor(cursorOffset:-1) → withPlugins loads loadBuiltinPlugins()+loadPlugins(plugins) → core.formatWithCursor → coreFormat: parseText → printAstToDoc → printDocToStringWithoutNormalizeOptions.

Parser/printer resolve loops plugins.findLast so later plugins override builtins (comment: temporarily solution, see #13729). Missing parser/printer throws ConfigError; in PRETTIER_TARGET=universal the message says plugins must be added to the standalone bundle.
JS print dispatch in printWithoutParentheses tries printAngular, printJsx, printFlow, printTypescript, then printEstree in order, returning the first defined Doc.

JS babel parser is createParser(createParse(...)) over @babel/parser with errorRecovery, a long plugin list (doExpressions, decorators, pipelineOperator combinations, etc.), then postprocess. Tests for those plugins live in tests/format/js/babel-plugins/ and are generated by scripts/update-babel-plugin-tests.js.
oxc parser uses oxc-parser parseSync with preserveParens:true, maps labels to Prettier loc errors via index-to-position, and shares postprocess/createParser with other JS parsers.

Playground flow: PrettierFormat setup() watches code/options/version → worker.format → WorkerApi posts to /worker.mjs?version=… → worker replies {uid, message, error}. Website README requires yarn build:website so UMD bundles exist in static/lib/.

Config persistence is not a write of Prettier state: --write overwrites source files; --cache writes .prettier-cache JSON via file-entry-cache.reconcile(); clearConfigCache clears prettier-config, editorconfig, and plugin import caches.

testing_signals.summary: Jest 30 with jest-light-runner drives four suites: snapshot format tests, CLI/API integration tests, unit tests, and dts tests. Format tests are directory fixtures plus runFormatTest, which implicitly adds extra JS parsers and, under FULL_TEST=1, AST-compare, second-format, EOL, and BOM checks. Production tests install dist/prettier and also run standalone and browser (Puppeteer) matrices. Unit tests are skipped in production; integration tests are skipped in standalone/browser.

claims.claim: jest.config.js testMatch: tests/format/**/format.test.js, tests/integration/__tests__/**/*.js, tests/unit/**/*.js, tests/dts/unit/**/*.js. Runner is jest-light-runner (child-process unless ENABLE_CODE_COVERAGE). Snapshot serializers: jest-snapshot-serializer-raw and -ansi.

runFormatTest(import.meta, parsers, options) is the format-test DSL. getParsers implicitly adds acorn/espree/meriyah/oxc/yuku when babel is listed under tests/format/js|jsx; babel-ts/oxc-ts/yuku-ts when typescript is listed; hermes when flow is listed; __babel_estree when babel is listed.

test-format.js snapshots eolVisualizedOutput via createSnapshot; expectFail directories use toThrowErrorMatchingSnapshot. Additional FULL_TEST checks are described in CONTRIBUTING.md (compare AST, second format, CRLF/CR, BOM) and implemented under tests/config/format-test/.

tests/format is partitioned by language (js, jsx, typescript, flow, css, scss, less, html, vue, angular, markdown, mdx, yaml, graphql, handlebars, json, mjml, lwc, misc) with per-directory __snapshots__/format.test.js.snap. Flow’s tests/format/flow/flow-repo/ is synced via scripts/sync-flow-tests.cjs, not edited by hand.

Integration tests cover CLI behaviors (check, write, cache, patterns, ignore, stdin, plugins, config-resolution, experimental-cli, node-version-check, help-options) with snapshot files under tests/integration/__tests__/__snapshots__/.

Unit tests (tests/unit/) cover doc-printer, doc-builders, ast-path, visitor-keys, config-loader, resolve-parser, builtin-plugins, editorconfig-to-prettier, massage-ast; they are ignored when NODE_ENV=production. Bundle tests are ignored in development.

Production Jest installs the built package via tests/config/install-prettier.js into a temp node_modules/prettier (unless SKIP_PRODUCTION_INSTALL); TEST_STANDALONE and TEST_RUNTIME=browser remap the entry and skip tests/integration/. Browser tests skip several plugin/front-matter format tests.

package.json test scripts: test=jest; test:dev-package=INSTALL_PACKAGE=1; test:production=NODE_ENV=production; test:production-standalone=TEST_STANDALONE=1; test:production:browser with TEST_RUNTIME_BROWSER chrome|firefox and TEST_BUNDLE_FORMAT umd. Coverage via c8 include src/** and bin/**.

Lint CI also runs yarn lint:format-test (scripts/format-test-lint.js), prettier check on docs with PRETTIER_DEBUG=true so embedded format errors throw, yarn lint:deps, tsc, knip (separate lint:knip script), and codecov upload of coverage/lcov.info.

Release-script tests live in scripts/release/tests/; dts tests in tests/dts/unit/run.js (skipped on Node <=14). Dummy plugins under tests/config/prettier-plugins/ exercise embed/async printer/missing comments.

Prod CLI job runs dist/prettier on Node v0.10.48 solely to assert the engines check message 'Prettier requires at least version 14 of Node.js' — the production engine floor advertised by that job is 14, while package.json engines.node is >=22 for this source tree.

risk_map.summary: The largest security surface is intentional code execution: config files and plugins are imported from user-controlled paths, and --write overwrites arbitrary matched files. Plugin last-wins lets a later plugin replace builtin parsers/printers. Cache writes with restrictAccessToCwd:false. Generated plugin registries and the dist/ publish boundary are easy to edit in the wrong place. Option policy and the removed custom-parser API are social/API traps, not memory-safety bugs.

claims.claim: loadPlugin/importPlugin will import() a URL, an absolute path, a cwd-relative file, or a node_modules specifier via importFromDirectory (import-meta-resolve from a fake noop.js parent). This is how --plugin and config plugins run third-party code in-process.

JS/TS Prettier configs are executed, not parsed: loaders['.js'|'.mjs'|'.cjs'|'.ts'|'.mts'|'.cts'] = importModuleDefault via import(pathToFileURL(file)). External string configs try requireFromFile first then importFromFile.

--write calls mockable.writeFormattedFile(filename, output) which is fs.writeFile; expandPatterns can match any non-ignored file under cwd. docs/cli.md warns this overwrites files. process.exitCode is set per-file rather than aborting the whole run on a single IO error.

FormatResultsCache constructs file-entry-cache with restrictAccessToCwd: false. --cache-location can point anywhere that is not a directory; default falls back to os.tmpdir() if find-cache-directory fails.

Parser/printer lookup uses plugins.findLast, so a user or config plugin can silently replace babel/estree/html printers. Integration tests exist for plugin-override-builtin-printers and plugin-override-buitin-plugins (filename typo).

scripts/release/release.js uses child_process.exec(command) for git fetch --tags and yarn before importing run.js. The comment says it cannot use dependencies because they may not be installed yet. This is maintainer-only, not the formatter runtime.

development-plugins.js and production-plugins.js are generated ('do NOT edit'); editing them by hand will be overwritten by yarn generate-builtin-plugins. Production plugin graph (src/plugins/*.js) is a different split than language-* modules.

src/index.cjs in non-production throws if prettier.util or prettier.doc is accessed (ESM-only in dev CJS). Production CJS requires those files directly. Mixing NODE_ENV and CJS consumers is a support trap.
Custom Parser API was removed in v3.0.0 (docs/api.md); plugins must use the Plugin API. printer.embed with >2 parameters throws, telling authors the v3 plugin API changed.
No-new-options policy is enforced socially: CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/option-philosophy.md say option-request PRs are closed without discussion. Agents that add a formatting flag will be rejected.

handleError maps UndefinedParserError to exit 2 (or ignore with --ignore-unknown); ConfigError/validation calls process.exit(1) immediately (fails the whole CLI); parse errors set exitCode 2 and continue. Check mode uses exit 1 for unformatted files.

Website playground Worker loads /worker.mjs?version= and production Vite aliases npm deps to esm.sh CDN URLs (website/vite.config.mjs buildCdnAlias). That is a supply-chain/runtime dependency of prettier.io, not of the formatter library.

extension_points.summary: New languages are plugins: export languages/parsers/printers/options and load via --plugin, options.plugins, or config. Builtins are the same API, registered in the generated lazy-load tables. JS syntax work lands in src/language-js/parse and the printAngular/printJsx/printFlow/printTypescript/printEstree chain. Doc commands are the IR extension point. CLI flags are two tables (cli-options.evaluate.js and core-options.evaluate.js). Config file names are the CONFIG_FILES array.

claims.claim: A plugin is a module (default or named exports) with languages, parsers (parse/astFormat/locStart/locEnd/hasPragma/preprocess), printers (print/embed/massageAstNode/hasPrettierIgnore/getVisitorKeys), options, defaultOptions.

toLazyLoadPlugin turns {name, load, parsers[], printers[]} into objects whose parsers/printers entries are async thunks that import() the real module on first use — the intended way builtins stay tree-shakeable.

Adding a production-bundled parser means adding src/plugins/<name>.js (see src/plugins/babel.js re-exporting language-js/parse/babel plus json parsers) and regenerating production-plugins.js. Dev mode loads language-*/index.js instead.

JS printer extension: add a node-type handler in src/language-js/print/{estree,jsx,typescript,flow,angular}.js; printWithoutParentheses tries those five in order. Comment attachment hooks are canAttachComment/handleComments/willPrintOwnComments on the estree printer.

JS parser extension: export from src/language-js/parse/<engine>.js via createParser, then re-export from parse/index.js. babel.js documents the add/remove plugin checklist (tests/format/js/babel-plugins + scripts/update-babel-plugin-tests.js).

Doc IR extension for printers is the builders in src/document/builders (group, fill, ifBreak, indent, line, cursor, label, trim, …) plus printer.printDocToString. prettier.doc.utils exposes traverseDoc/mapDoc/willBreak. concat is a deprecated alias for identity on arrays, TODO remove in v4.

CLI option tables: src/cli/cli-options.evaluate.js (CLI-only) merged with API options from getSupportInfo via apiOptionToCliOption in get-context-options.js. New forwarded flags belong in core-options.evaluate.js with cliName/cliCategory.

CONFIG_FILES in config-searcher.js is the ordered list of config filenames; loaders.js maps extensions to load functions. Adding a config format means both arrays. Search uses search-closest FileSearcher with a stopDirectory mockable.

Language metadata is linguist-languages plus createLanguage() in each languages.evaluate.js (extensions, filenames, vscodeLanguageIds, interpreters). inferParser matches basename, then extension, then shebang interpreter.

In-repo extra plugins under packages/plugin-{oxc,hermes,yuku} are the template for shipping an alternate JS parser as a separate npm package: remap astFormat, reuse estree printer, export languages/options from the core tree. They are included in the dist build package list.

__debug APIs (parse, formatAST, formatDoc, printToDoc, printDocToString) and __internal (shared with CLI) are the in-tree hooks tests and the CLI use; they are not documented as stable public API. mockable objects in src/common/mockable.js and src/cli/mockable.js exist so tests can stub writeFormattedFile/isTTY/getTimestamp.
changelog_unreleased/<area>/<pr>.md plus yarn generate-changelog is the required contributor extension point for user-facing changes; PRs without it may be closed.

report.agent_prompt:
You are working in the Prettier repo (prettier/prettier, version 3.10.0-dev on main). Prettier is an opinionated code formatter: parse source to an AST, attach comments, print a Wadler-style Doc IR, then serialize with print-width-aware group breaking. It is not a style linter and it does not accept new formatting options (see docs/option-philosophy.md and CONTRIBUTING.md). Prefer small diffs.

Public surfaces
- Node ESM API: src/index.js (format, check, formatWithCursor, resolveConfig, resolveConfigFile, clearConfigCache, getFileInfo, getSupportInfo, doc, util, __debug, __internal). All public APIs are async.
- Node CJS shim: src/index.cjs (dynamic-import wrapper; util/doc only work when NODE_ENV=production).
- CLI: bin/prettier.cjs → src/cli/index.js run(). Optional experimental CLI: --experimental-cli or PRETTIER_EXPERIMENTAL_CLI loads @prettier/cli via src/experimental-cli/index.js.
- Browser: src/standalone.js (no config/ignore/autoload; pass plugins explicitly, including estree for JS).

Format pipeline (src/main/core.js)
withPlugins → normalizeFormatOptions (infer parser from filepath) → normalizeInputAndOptions (BOM/EOL) → parse (src/main/parse.js) → printAstToDoc (comments + embed + printer.print) → printDocToString (src/document/printer/printer.js). Parser/printer resolved with plugins.findLast (later plugins override builtins) in src/main/parser-and-printer.js.

Languages live in src/language-{js,json,css,html,graphql,handlebars,markdown,yaml}. JS print order is printAngular, printJsx, printFlow, printTypescript, printEstree (src/language-js/print/index.js). Builtin plugin registries src/main/plugins/builtin-plugins/{development,production}-plugins.js are generated — after changing languages/options/parsers/printers run `yarn generate-builtin-plugins`.

Config search order is src/config/prettier-config/config-searcher.js (package.json prettier key first, then .prettierrc*, prettier.config.*, toml). JS/TS configs are import()ed and therefore execute code. CLI --write overwrites files; --cache uses file-entry-cache at node_modules/.cache/prettier/.prettier-cache.

Tests
Jest + jest-light-runner. Format fixtures: tests/format/<lang>/<topic>/format.test.js must call runFormatTest(import.meta, ["babel"|…]). Listing babel under js/jsx also runs acorn, espree, meriyah, oxc, yuku; typescript also runs babel-ts, oxc-ts, yuku-ts; flow also runs hermes. Update snapshots with yarn test -u. FULL_TEST=1 adds AST compare, second format, EOL, BOM. Integration: tests/integration/__tests__. Unit: tests/unit (skipped in production). After `yarn build`, yarn test:production hits dist/prettier (Node 14+ in CI). Dev engines.node is >=22; package manager yarn@4.18.0.

Do not
- Add formatting options or “preserve original line breaks” behavior.
- Hand-edit generated builtin-plugin files.
- Publish from the source tree (prepublishOnly exits 1; publish from dist/).
- Assume standalone autoloads plugins.

For user-facing changes add changelog_unreleased/<area>/<id>.md. Lint/format with yarn fix. Debug without building via yarn debug <file>.
